services.title: Transmission Service

services.title: AC and Heating

services.title: Suspension and Alignment

services.title: Electrical and Battery
services.body: Alternator, starter, battery load testing. Wiring diagnosis for parasitic draws, intermittent faults, and no-crank conditions.

faqs.a: Appointments are preferred so we can reserve a bay. But we take walk-ins when space is available. Call ahead and we can usually get you in the same day for oil changes and diagnostics.
Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM. Saturday, 8 AM to 2 PM. Closed Sunday. Saturday mornings fill fast, so call early in the week to reserve a Saturday slot.

faqs.q: Do you work on all makes and models?
faqs.a: Yes. Honda, Toyota, Chevy, Ford, Subaru, Hyundai, Kia, Nissan, BMW, Volkswagen. Domestic and import, car, truck, and SUV. If it has an engine, we work on it.

faqs.q: How much does a diagnostic cost?
faqs.a: Engine diagnostic starts at $89. That covers the OBD-II scan, hands-on inspection, and a written quote. If you approve the repair, the $89 applies toward the total.

faqs.q: Do you do Ohio E-Check emissions testing?
faqs.a: Yes. We are a licensed Ohio E-Check station. If the vehicle fails, we diagnose the issue and quote the repair before you leave. No second trip to another shop.

faqs.q: Can I wait while my car is being serviced?
faqs.a: Yes. We have a waiting area with seating, Wi-Fi, and a coffee machine. Oil changes and brake jobs typically finish within 90 minutes. For longer repairs, we will call you with a pickup time.

faqs.q: Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
faqs.a: Every repair is backed by a 24-month, 24,000-mile warranty on parts and labor. The warranty terms are printed on your invoice.
